pages.text: Welcome to $(thing)TerraFirma: Rebirth$() (TFCR)!$(br2)A lightly-modded pack built around $(thing)TerraFirmaCraft: TNG$(), woven together with Create, Immersive Engineering, Aeronautics and Cosmonautics. We keep each mod's native gameplay intact and let it truly grow into the TFC world. Runs are long — slow down and enjoy the journey from the Stone Age to the Moon.

pages.text: $(li)Pack version: $(thing)4.1.21 Release$()$()$(br)$(li)Game: Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge)$()$(br)$(li)TerraFirmaCraft: TNG 4.2.8$()$(br2)A stable release, recommended for long-term survival worlds. Found something odd? Tell the dev team — every report makes the pack better.
